description: arXiv:2609.19377v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recovering numerical series from line plots requires accurate axis calibration and reliable curve extraction. We present LinePilot Digitizer (LinePilot), which combines continuous color-based curve recovery with three calibration modes: LinePilot (standard), LinePilot (enhanced), and LinePilot (OCR).
